ProgramUnit.Name: RELOAD_INFORMATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this is where we reload the information from the database
*/

PROCEDURE reload_information IS
 szWhereClause varchar2(400);
BEGIN
 :ctrl_etor.event_date := sysdate;

 /*
 ** compile the where clause
 */
 szWhereClause := szWhereClause || 'trunc(event_date) = ' || in_quotes(trunc(:ctrl_etor.event_date)) ||
 ' and (for_the_day = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.for_the_day) ||
 ' or for_the_week = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.for_the_week) ||
 ' or for_the_month = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.for_the_month) ||
 ' or birth_date_flag = ' || in_quotes('Y') ||
 ' or company_event = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.company_event) ||
 ' or local_event = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.local_event) ||
 ' or state_event = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.state_event) ||
 ' or national_event = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.national_event) ||
 ' or international_event = ' || in_quotes(:ctrl_etor.international_event) || ')';

 set_block_property('events_to_remember', default_where, szWhereclause);
 go_block('events_to_remember');
 execute_query;
END;

DECLARE

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;

declare
